critical_code_review_comments: AutoBidModal.jsx line 149 (`if (!lot) return null`) short-circuits the entire component when lot is null. Combined with Dialog open-state driven by !!autoBidLot, if a stale render sends open=false + lot=null while a new render is queued with open=true + lot=…, Radix Dialog may not properly mount the portal. Safer pattern: keep the <Dialog> wrapper always mounted and guard only the inner children with `{lot && <>…</>}`.

MultiItemListingDetailPage.js has TWO Auto-Bid state variables (`autoBidModalOpen` at line 87 — never used, and `autoBidLot` at line 104 — the real one). Remove the dead `autoBidModalOpen` state to reduce cognitive load.

rca of the issue: AutoBid modal UI bug RCA (best guess): CompactLotCard onClick → onOpenAutoBid(lot) → parent setAutoBidLot(lot) → AutoBidModal receives new lot prop + open={!!autoBidLot}=true. AutoBidModal line 149 `if (!lot) return null` short-circuits the component BEFORE Radix Dialog can register as controlled. On the transition from lot=null (return null) to lot=<obj> (Dialog rendered), Radix sees a fresh unmount/mount pair rather than an open-state change, which in some conditions (particularly with concurrent React 18 batching) causes the portal to fail to attach. Fix: hoist the <Dialog> above the null guard so it always renders, then gate the inner content on `lot &&`.
